UC Botanical Garden：上山与停车: UC Botanical Garden: transport and parking
H shuttle 仅工作日，停车另计且不保证车位。: The H shuttle runs on weekdays only; parking costs extra and spaces are not guaranteed.
路径包括坡道、碎石与台阶，请按行动需要选线。: Paths include slopes, gravel and steps; choose a route for your mobility needs.
Berkeley 好玩的反差，是上午还在图书馆外的草地看学生来往，稍后就站在山坡: Berkeley’s charm lies in the shift from students crossing a library lawn to plant labels on a hillside. These are not parts of one flat park: campus is easy to explore casually, while the Botanical Garden sits in Strawberry Canyon and needs a separate uphill connection. This plan pairs a university visit with a closer look at plants, with room to shorten either part.
先分开安排校园与植物园: Plan campus and garden visits separately
建议预留 3.5–4.5 小时；校园外景约一小时，植物园约两小时，中间留交通缓冲: Allow 3.5–4.5 hours: about an hour outdoors on campus, two at the garden and time for the connection.
校园公共室外路线免门票；植物园成人 $18，65+ 与非 UCB 学生 $12，: The public outdoor campus route has no admission fee. Garden tickets are $18 for adults, $12 for ages 65+ and non-UCB students, $8 for ages 5–17, and free for children 4 and under. Check ID requirements for discounts.
植物园通常 10:00–17:00，16:30 最后入场，周二关闭；温室与 Re: The garden normally opens 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with last entry at 4:30 p.m., and closes Tuesdays. Greenhouses and Redwood Grove close earlier, at 4 p.m. Advance reservations are recommended for general visitors.
从钟楼草坪走向山中植物: From campus lawns to hillside plants
两段路线：校园不赶场，花园选一条环线: Two parts: unhurried campus views and one garden loop
停留时长是编辑建议，不含往返交通；按现场开放和同行者体力调整。: Suggested stop durations are editorial estimates and exclude travel to and from the area. Adjust for closures and your group’s energy.
先逛 · Sather Gate 到 Memorial Glade: Start: Sather Gate to Memorial Glade
看校门、钟楼外景与草坪，选一个位置坐十分钟。建筑内部能否进入按门口规定，登钟楼不: See the gate, the tower from outside and the lawns. Sit for ten minutes. Follow posted building-access rules; climbing the tower is not included in this free outdoor route.
导航到 200 Centennial Drive。工作日可查 Hearst Mi: Head to 200 Centennial Drive. On weekdays, check the H shuttle from Hearst Mining Circle. It does not run weekends; occasional overflow-parking shuttles are not campus connections.
慢慢看 · 主路与当天开放的植物区: Explore: main paths and open plant areas
先拿地图，选两三个地理植物区，比较叶片与生长环境；拍完标签再拍植物，回家能继续认: Pick up a map and choose two or three geographic collections. Compare leaves and habitats, photographing labels before plants so you can learn more later. Return to the entrance for your planned ride downhill.
停车场在花园入口对面，官网列 $1.50/小时，数量有限；手机信号也可能弱，先保: The lot across from the garden entrance is listed at $1.50 per hour, with limited spaces. Reception can be weak, so save payment and return-trip details. The campus-to-garden link is a climb: the garden recommends walking or cycling only for visitors comfortable with at least half an hour uphill. Wheelchair users and families with small-wheeled strollers should check the surface map and ask staff for a suitable short route.
上山前，确认交通与同行者体力: Before heading uphill: transport and your group’s energy
确认当天不是周二或临时闭园日，想看温室就把它排早。: Check Tuesday and special closures; visit greenhouses early.
先定上山和下山方式，比赛日另查校园道路调整。: Plan both uphill and downhill transport; check campus road changes on game days.
保存门票、停车付款方式与官方地图，带水和防晒。: Save admission, parking-payment details and the official map; bring water and sun protection.
打开官方页面，按实际出行日期核对后再订票或出发。: Check the official page for your travel date before booking or setting out.
